subject: Priority: referred candidate — ownership + scheduling for Asha Reddy
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Intro: Asha Reddy (referred) — asking for priority scheduling

Ben —

Hope you’re well. Quick intro: I’m referring a candidate for Senior Infra Engineer, Asha Reddy (resumes attached). Asha comes recommended by a former colleague at PlatformScale — strong infra background (distributed systems, low-latency services, worked on infra for ML pipelines).

Can you own intake + scheduling for this one and treat it as a priority? Hiring manager is Laura (cc’d) — she’s keen to move quickly. High-level ask: get a 30–45 min intro screen with Evelyn (recruiter) + a 60 min loop if screen looks good. Ideally have an intro screen on Friday or Monday.

Attachments: Asha_Reddy_Resume.pdf (resume)

Why priority: referred by someone we trust and is a good flight risk — Sandeep (external) flagged other offers.

Thanks — appreciate a quick confirmation that you’ll take ownership.

—
Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 16:04:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Intro: Asha Reddy (referred) — asking for priority scheduling

Thanks Monica — I got it and I'll take point.

Evelyn/Laura — I’ll coordinate with Asha and Sandeep to lock an initial screen. Proposed plan:
- 30m phone/video screen with Evelyn to confirm fundamentals and interest
- 60m technical loop with Laura + two infra engineers if screen passes

Evelyn: can you share availability windows Fri 10/02 14:00–17:00 PT, Mon 10/05 09:00–12:00 PT? I’ll reach out to Asha and push one of those. I attached a short mutual action plan for tracking (mutual_action_plan.docx).

Monica — noted about competing offers. I’ll mark this high priority.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.docx

—
Ben Carter
Senior Recruiter (Technical Hiring Lead), Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 510-555-0110

Subject: Re: Intro: Asha Reddy (referred) — post-loop debrief + next steps

Folks — quick debrief after loop on 10/05. Attendees: Laura, Rohit, Kim, Asha (candidate). Summary:
- Strengths: clear systems thinking, recent experience on low-latency KV service, strong debugging examples.
- Areas to probe: deeper examples on operationalizing models at scale (Asha had limited exposure to model-serving infra specifically).
- Recommendation: move forward to final hiring discussion; ask for a brief take-home design exercise (2–3 hour) focused on model-serving reliability, or set a focused follow-up with someone from AI infra.

I attached a filled scorecard: asha_scorecard.docx — overall "Strong Hire" with conditional for final step. Proposed timeline: decision by 10/07. Monica, given the referral, we may want to expedite approval if compensation falls within band. Laura — can you confirm you can be decision owner for 10/07?

Thanks — Ben

Attachments: asha_scorecard.docx
